description: Silicone is a Python package developed by Grantham Institute researchers to fill missing emissions series in integrated assessment model scenarios. It estimates, for example, aerosol-precursor or nitrous-oxide trajectories from reported gases by learning relationships in more complete scenario sets. Users supply incomplete and reference emissions time series plus an infilling method; outputs are estimated series for missing gases and years. Geographic coverage and future horizon follow the input scenario database. The project publishes BSD-3-Clause source, package installation steps and online documentation. A limitation is that inferred gases depend on the reference scenario population and are estimates, not newly observed emissions. Silicone can prepare more complete climate pathways for infrastructure exposure and decarbonisation simulations. The catalogue's data-ipcc-ar6-scenarios-database is a separate scenario collection that could be an input, but this pairing was not executed. No scenario database or package was downloaded.
